text:
maya.design: Quick design review for the threshold composer + preview. The suppression tag and routing tag are blending visually in the compact preview. Posting the new frame: https://img.redwood.local/frames/preview_compact.png
noah.prod: they do look similar at 320px. users skim quickly and might hit the wrong toggle. can we change suppression to an outlined capsule and keep routing filled?
zara.eng: outlined capsules need a stronger stroke for some themes. propose outline 2px neutral-700 on light theme, 2px neutral-200 on dark, and a left color accent to aid scanning.
liam.sre: keyboard note: the capsule grouping isn't currently keyboard-separable. Tab focus jumps the whole group. We should make each pill a focusable control and ship roving tabindex so arrow keys navigate within the group.
tess.content: copy tweak: the pill label "Suppress" reads better than "Suppression" inside tight UI. Tooltip can expand: "Suppress alerts for 2 hours". Also suggest changing empty state copy to "No thresholds yet 1 Create a threshold to start alerting."
maya.design: good call on shorter label. Also want the suppression banner to be attached, not floating. Floating toasts obscure buttons on small screens. Attach a tiny inline callout above pills with chevron to expand details.
zara.eng: implementation constraint: callout must remain after DOM updates to avoid screen reader loss. We'll keep a stable container id and update inner text only. Add aria-live=polite and role=status so it's announced without forcing.
liam.sre: watch out for rapid edits triggering many announcements. Add a 300ms debounce before updating aria-live text and ensure we never use assertive.
maya.design: accessibility: add visible focus ring that is not color-dependent (2px white/black outline depending on theme) and ensure reduced-motion honors prefers-reduced-motion for expand/collapse.	ess.content: microcopy: for the expanded channel list show: "Affected channels: #ops, #alerts (+2)" and on small screens show a truncated list with a "View all" link.
oah.prod: final ask: breadcrumbs and page header are pushing the preview down on small viewports. Let's collapse breadcrumbs into a single compact crumb and pin preview above the fold.
maya.design: will update mocks with outlined suppression, shorter labels, attached inline callout, roving tabindex, debounce for aria-live, and compact breadcrumb. tagging @zara.eng and @liam.sre to verify DOM contract.
accessbot: recorded: design action items: outlined suppression pill, roving tabindex for pill group, aria-live debounce 300ms, inline attached callout, short pill labels, compact breadcrumb, reduced-motion support.
maya.design: thanks all 1 I'll post new Figma frames and link results from a color-blindness pass.
